title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story March 1989 #120 - Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics Dave Sim
descriptionText:
This comic book is a must-have for fans of Cerebus the Aardvark. It features Jaka's story from March 1989, issue number 120. Written and illustrated by Dave Sim, this single issue comic book is part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) era of US comics.

The comic book is in great shape and perfect for collectors of comics and graphic novels. It belongs to the genre of comics and is published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. The character of Cerebus is featured in the comic book. Don't miss out on adding this to your collection!
